I replied to Marcus in his DM to confirm that his Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups for the Juniper project now go through Gate 35.

The workspace brain had already saved his message as a fact under his private source, so I didn't need to save anything else. I won't bring up this detail with anyone else or in any channel.

One thing to flag: the brain marks that saved fact as "world" visibility, even though it came from a private DM. Under the workspace rules it should only be shown to Marcus, so the brain owner may want to check that setting.
